__inputs.name: DS_LOKI
__inputs.label: Loki
__inputs.description: Select the Loki datasource that receives the OTel logs.

description: alp の JSON 集計と同じ nginx access log を Loki から run ID ごとに確認するための dashboard。response_time と body_bytes は nginx 側の値です。

panels.description: alp の COUNT / 2XX / 4XX / 5XX に対応します。run ID のない readiness probe は除外されます。

targets.expr: sum by (method, uri) (count_over_time({service_name="nginx"} | json | benchmark_run_id="${benchmark_run_id}" | status=~"2.." [$__range]))
sum by (method, uri) (count_over_time({service_name="nginx"} | json | benchmark_run_id="${benchmark_run_id}" | status=~"4.." [$__range]))
sum by (method, uri) (count_over_time({service_name="nginx"} | json | benchmark_run_id="${benchmark_run_id}" | status=~"5.." [$__range]))

panels.title: Requests by URI

panels.description: alp の MIN / MAX / AVG / P90 / P95 / P99 に対応する nginx $request_time（秒）です。

targets.expr: min by (method, uri) (min_over_time({service_name="nginx"} | json | benchmark_run_id="${benchmark_run_id}" | unwrap response_time [$__range]))
max by (method, uri) (max_over_time({service_name="nginx"} | json | benchmark_run_id="${benchmark_run_id}" | unwrap response_time [$__range]))
avg by (method, uri) (avg_over_time({service_name="nginx"} | json | benchmark_run_id="${benchmark_run_id}" | unwrap response_time [$__range]))
max by (method, uri) (quantile_over_time(0.90, {service_name="nginx"} | json | benchmark_run_id="${benchmark_run_id}" | unwrap response_time [$__range]))
max by (method, uri) (quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="nginx"} | json | benchmark_run_id="${benchmark_run_id}" | unwrap response_time [$__range]))
max by (method, uri) (quantile_over_time(0.99, {service_name="nginx"} | json | benchmark_run_id="${benchmark_run_id}" | unwrap response_time [$__range]))

panels.title: Server latency by URI

panels.description: alp の MIN(BODY) / MAX(BODY) / SUM(BODY) / AVG(BODY) に対応します。

targets.expr: min by (method, uri) (min_over_time({service_name="nginx"} | json | benchmark_run_id="${benchmark_run_id}" | unwrap body_bytes [$__range]))
max by (method, uri) (max_over_time({service_name="nginx"} | json | benchmark_run_id="${benchmark_run_id}" | unwrap body_bytes [$__range]))
sum by (method, uri) (sum_over_time({service_name="nginx"} | json | benchmark_run_id="${benchmark_run_id}" | unwrap body_bytes [$__range]))
avg by (method, uri) (avg_over_time({service_name="nginx"} | json | benchmark_run_id="${benchmark_run_id}" | unwrap body_bytes [$__range]))
